content.short: Dynamic is a web3 login solution offering easy onboarding, embedded wallet options, and developer tools for authentication, authorization and onboarding.
content.description: Dynamic is a Web3 login solution built for broad adoption, offering straightforward onboarding and embedded wallet options to help newcomers get started while delivering elegant, secure login flows tuned for crypto-native users. By abstracting the complexities of user management, Dynamic provides developers with robust tools for authentication, authorization, and onboarding, enabling seamless sign-in and smooth onboarding journeys across decentralized applications.
content.meta: Dynamic offers web3 login for everyone with easy onboarding and embedded wallet options. Discover Dynamic and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: A Deep Dive Into TSS-MPC
resources.tldr: What threshold signature schemes are, how they differ from other flavours of multi-party computation, and the security properties that follow from each choice.

resources.title: Beyond the Speed Myth: TSS-MPC Performance
resources.tldr: The standing objection to threshold signatures has been latency. Argues that objection is now several years out of date, and shows where the time actually goes.

resources.title: Building Identity-Based Mini Apps With World ID
resources.tldr: Gating an app on proof of personhood rather than on a wallet balance. A practical walkthrough of what verified human access changes about the design.
